summary: Centre County tree lookout: 1908 report urged a station on Bald Mountain Knob; 1914 tree post with 35-ft viewing point; register says no longer standing.

facts.status_note: No longer standing according to the FFLOS register.

events.note: State forestry report urged lookout stations, including one on Bald Mountain Knob with a fifty-foot tower suggested. Not confirmed built as proposed.
Tree observation post with viewing point 35 feet above ground. Register calls it a tree tower built in 1914.
Register says the tree tower was still in service circa 1917.
Registered September 16, 2008, nominated by Henry Isenberg.

evidence.supports: Bald Mountain lies in Centre County, Pennsylvania
1908 report called for lookout stations on several points
evidence.quote: look-out stations should be built on several points commanding a good view of the surrounding country.

evidence.supports: 1908 report named a point on Bald Mountain Knob as especially desirable, along the road from Milroy to Potter's Bank
evidence.quote: A point on Bald Mountain Knob along the road from Milroy to Potter's Bank is especially desirable

evidence.supports: the spot was near telephone lines
evidence.quote: because of its nearness to both the Bell and United telephone lines.

evidence.supports: the 1908 report proposed a fifty-foot tower there
evidence.quote: with a fifty feet tower and telephone connection there is no reason why such a station should not do good work.

evidence.supports: 1914 tree observation post with viewing point 35 feet above the ground
evidence.quote: 1914: A tree observation post was established, the viewing point at 35 feet above the ground.

evidence.supports: register calls it a tree tower built in 1914, still in service circa 1917
evidence.quote: This tree tower was built in 1914 and was still in service circa 1917.

evidence.supports: register says the tower is no longer standing
the lookout history lists the site as removed, with no date

sources.title: Bald Mountain Tower Site
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites register, Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one 1908 forestry report, a 1914 post, and the register. Height 10.7 m is the 35-ft viewing point of the 1914 post, not a confirmed tower height. Removal date unknown. No staffing, fires or current-site description found. Neither source gives coordinates, so the brief's lat/lon (40.75257, -77.63389) could not be checked. A search returned a 'Friends of Bald Mountain Preservation Project' page with photos of a tower; it is not clearly this site, so it is not used.
